'''Shanpan''' was the capital city of [[Manpha/Legends|Manpha]]. It was inhabited by the [[Shawda Ubb/Legends|Shawda Ubb]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] only [[Shanpan|spaceport]].
